title: Websites & service portals
description: Help residents find a service, understand what they need and finish the task on a phone.
keywords: Resident experience Websites & service portals Help residents find a service, understand what they need and finish the task on a phone. Where to start Someone applying for a permit may have to piece together a department page, a PDF and a conversation by phone. Start by putting the instructions in one place. Open the interactive demo ↗ What the work includes Service design Map resident questions to plain-language pages. Test the navigation against tasks such as renewing a license or requesting a record. Content migration Inventory pages and documents, assign owners, map redirects and rehearse the cutover on a staging site. Editorial handover Give editors reusable page patterns and a publishing checklist. Walk an editor through a change before launch. How to evaluate it Ask a first-time visitor to locate the right service, check eligibility and open the application using only a keyboard. Ask an editor to update that same page. Try the demonstration ↗ What affects scope To estimate the work, count pages and documents, identify required languages and check the current CMS. Include integrations, editor permissions and the launch date. Open the planning guide ↗ Scope and pricing ↗

title: Forms & workflow automation
description: Connect the resident’s application to the staff queue, review decision and receipt.
keywords: Service operations Forms & workflow automation Connect the resident’s application to the staff queue, review decision and receipt. Where to start A complete online form can still create hours of retyping. Follow one application all the way to the person who reviews it. Open the interactive demo ↗ What the work includes Intake and validation Define the required fields, conditional questions and supporting documents with the people who review them. Staff review Make ownership, status changes, requests for corrections and decision history visible in one place. Integration and export Agree on identifiers and field definitions. Reconcile sample records against the existing system before go-live. How to evaluate it Submit a sample application and ask for a correction. Return the corrected record to staff for approval. Compare the final record with the history and the receipt. Try the demonstration ↗ What affects scope Review roles, exception paths, payment providers, identity systems and retention rules affect the build. Open the planning guide ↗ Scope and pricing ↗

title: Data systems & reporting
description: Give staff a map or dashboard backed by a reporting pipeline they can check against source records.
keywords: Decision support Data systems & reporting Give staff a map or dashboard backed by a reporting pipeline they can check against source records. Where to start When monthly totals differ between reports, staff need a way to trace the difference. Build the reconciliation step into the reporting process so staff can tell which records changed. Open the interactive demo ↗ What the work includes Source inventory Document the owner, format, refresh interval and allowed use of each source. Agree on a definition for each measure. Data preparation Validate incoming records, isolate exceptions and keep stable identifiers across refreshes. Maps and reporting Design filters around decisions, include documented calculations and export the selected records. For an AI-assisted task, test its answers against a labeled sample before release. How to evaluate it Filter a known sample, compare the count and sum to an independent calculation, then export the records and reproduce both numbers. Try the demonstration ↗ What affects scope Source quality, update frequency, geographic coverage, access rules and the number of reporting views drive effort. Open the planning guide ↗ Scope and pricing ↗
